acceptance: `make pr-open` accepts a PR_TITLE (or uses the first commit subject) so multi-commit PRs open with a descriptive title
pr-open refuses, or warns, when the resulting title equals the branch name
Documented in the PR workflow docs
context: Found in the tuning-local fix batch, 2026-10-17 (#3082).
description: `make pr-open` calls `gh pr create --fill` (Makefile:1164, 1166). For a branch with more than one commit, `--fill` uses the branch name as the PR title. #3082 opened from `fix/tuning-registry-followups` with two commits and merged with the squash subject "fix/tuning registry followups (#3082)" (f4ca650c9 on develop), which does not describe the change. The workaround of editing the title right after opening restarts and cancels CI (see pr-edit-cancels-ci-and-leaves-red-rows-20261017).
